chDump: umask 077; d=/dev/shm; [ -w "$d" ] || d=/tmp; f=$(mktemp "$d/tugra-dbcfg.XXXXXX") || exit 1; z=/var/lib/clickhouse/backups/tugra_backup.zip; trap "rm -f \"$f\" \"$z\"" EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; q=$(printf "\047"); x() { sed -e "s/&/\\&/g" -e "s/</\\</g" -e "s/>/\\>/g"; }; { printf "<clickhouse><user>"; printf "%s" "$1" | x; printf "</user><password>"; printf "%s" "$TUGRA_DB_PW" | x; printf "</password></clickhouse>\n"; } > "$f" || exit 1; umask 022; c() { clickhouse-client --config-file "$f" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9000 "$@" </dev/null; }; i=0; until c --query "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 30 ] && { echo "tugra: clickhouse not ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 2; done; mkdir -p /var/lib/clickhouse/backups; chown clickhouse:clickhouse /var/lib/clickhouse/backups 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$z"; c --query "BACKUP DATABASE \"$2\" TO File(${q}$z${q})" >/dev/null && cat "$z"; rc=$?; exit $rc
chRestore: umask 077; d=/dev/shm; [ -w "$d" ] || d=/tmp; f=$(mktemp "$d/tugra-dbcfg.XXXXXX") || exit 1; z=/var/lib/clickhouse/backups/tugra_restore.zip; trap "rm -f \"$f\" \"$z\"" EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; q=$(printf "\047"); x() { sed -e "s/&/\\&/g" -e "s/</\\</g" -e "s/>/\\>/g"; }; { printf "<clickhouse><user>"; printf "%s" "$1" | x; printf "</user><password>"; printf "%s" "$TUGRA_DB_PW" | x; printf "</password></clickhouse>\n"; } > "$f" || exit 1; umask 022; c() { clickhouse-client --config-file "$f" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9000 "$@" </dev/null; }; i=0; until c --query "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 30 ] && { echo "tugra: clickhouse not ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 2; done; mkdir -p /var/lib/clickhouse/backups; chown clickhouse:clickhouse /var/lib/clickhouse/backups 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$z"; cat > "$z" || exit 1; s=$(LC_ALL=C grep -a -o -m1 "metadata/[A-Za-z0-9_]*\\.sql" "$z" | head -n1 | sed -e "s#^metadata/##" -e "s#\\.sql\$##"); [ -n "$s" ] || { echo "tugra: not a clickhouse backup" >&2; exit 1; }; t="$2__tugra_restore_tmp"; c --query "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS \"$t\" SYNC" 2>/dev/null; c --query "RESTORE DATABASE \"$s\" AS \"$t\" FROM File(${q}$z${q})" >/dev/null && c --query "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS \"$2\" SYNC" && c --query "RENAME DATABASE \"$t\" TO \"$2\""; rc=$?; exit $rc

umask 077; d=/dev/shm; [ -w "$d" ] || d=/tmp; f=$(mktemp "$d/tugra-dbcfg.XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap "rm -f "$f"" EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; q=$(printf "\047"); x() { sed -e "s/&/\&/g" -e "s/</\</g" -e "s/>/\>/g"; }; { printf "<clickhouse><user>"; printf "%s" "$1" | x; printf "</user><password>"; printf "%s" "$TUGRA_DB_PW" | x; printf "</password></clickhouse>
"; } > "$f" || exit 1; umask 022; c() { clickhouse-client --config-file "$f" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9000 "$@" </dev/null; }; i=0; until c --query "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 30 ] && { echo "tugra: clickhouse not ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 2; done; L=$(c --query "SELECT name, total_rows FROM system.tables WHERE database = ${q}$2${q} AND NOT is_temporary AND engine NOT LIKE ${q}%View${q} AND engine != ${q}Dictionary${q} ORDER BY name" --format TSV) || exit 1; [ -n "$L" ] || exit 0; T=$(printf "	"); printf "%s

" "$t" "$est"; continue; fi; n=$(c --query "SELECT count() FROM "$2"."$t"") || { printf "%s	-1	0
" "$t"; continue; }; printf "%s	%s	0
" "$t" "$n"; done
